questions.question: How should the launcher stop xdist workers from crashing with MemoryError when free virtual memory is low?

options.label: Memory-aware cap (Recommended)
options.description: When RS_TEST_WORKERS is unset, compute_workers also caps the count at free commit memory divided by about 1 GB per worker (Windows: GlobalMemoryStatusEx via ctypes; POSIX: MemAvailable/sysconf). It prints the cap when it applies, and RS_TEST_WORKERS still wins. Your User env var then becomes optional. No new dependency.

options.label: Lower the static default
options.description: Change the CPU formula so a 20-thread box gets 8 (the measured setting), not 14. Simple, but it doesn't respond to actual memory, so a box short on commit memory can still crash.

options.label: Preflight warning only
options.description: Keep the count. Before starting, warn (or refuse) if free commit memory is under workers × 1 GB, telling you to set RS_TEST_WORKERS. Nothing changes automatically.

questions.question: How should the work be tracked and delivered?

options.label: New BK item + /ship PR (Recommended)
options.description: File a new BK item in § 7, with a trace, CHANGELOG, a test in tests/scripts/test_run_tests.py and a branch, then deliver it through /ship with review to convergence. Most expensive.

options.label: New BK item + plain /pr
options.description: Same artifacts and tests, but open the PR with /pr and skip the convergence review loop. Cheaper for a change confined to one script.

options.label: Branch only, no PR yet
options.description: Implement and commit on a feature branch with the backlog item, trace and CHANGELOG. You open the PR later.
